stories.title: Oekraïne is bereid om aanvallen op Russische oliesector te staken, als Rusland stopt met aanvallen op Oekraïense energiecentrales

en.title: Ukraine willing to halt attacks on Russian oil sector if Russia stops attacks on Ukrainian energy plants
en.summary: Ukraine's president requested additional missiles from the U.S. during a United Nations meeting, as part of discussions regarding a potential halt to attacks on Russian energy infrastructure in exchange for Russia ceasing strikes on Ukrainian power facilities.

stories.title: Dode en zeven gewonden bij aanvallen op Oekraïne, ook kapitein vrachtschip gedood

en.title: One dead and seven wounded in attacks on Ukraine, ship captain also killed
en.summary: Russian air strikes on multiple locations in Ukraine resulted in at least one death and seven injuries, with Russia claiming to have targeted Ukrainian energy and military facilities as well as logistics centers.

stories.title: Rijk mag buiten lokale politiek om een militair radarstation plaatsen in Gelders dorpje Herwijnen

en.title: National government permitted to install military radar station in Gelderland village of Herwijnen without local authorization
en.summary: The national government has been authorized to establish a military radar station in the village of Herwijnen in Gelderland, bypassing local political procedures.

stories.title: Militair radarstation mag toch worden gebouwd in Gelderse Herwijnen

en.title: Military radar station construction approved in Gelderse Herwijnen
en.summary: The Council of State rejected objections from residents and local authorities, allowing the Defense Ministry to proceed with constructing a military radar station in Herwijnen, Gelderland.

stories.title: Venezolaanse leider Rodríguez en Trump zien elkaar voor het eerst sinds inval

en.title: Venezuelan leader Rodríguez and Trump meet for first time since invasion
en.summary: Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodríguez and U.S. President Trump met in New York, marking their first encounter since the American invasion of Venezuela earlier this year that resulted in dictator Maduro's capture. The two discussed strengthening bilateral relations and humanitarian aid following June earthquakes.

stories.title: Elf doden bij schietpartij tijdens huisfeest in Zuid-Afrika, daders voortvluchtig

en.title: Eleven dead in shooting at house party in South Africa, perpetrators at large
en.summary: Three armed gunmen opened fire at a residence in Durban, South Africa during a house party on Tuesday evening, killing eleven people. The perpetrators fled the scene and their motive remains unknown.

stories.title: Live Oekraïne | Oekraïense kapitein gedood bij Russische aanval op Odesa

en.title: Live Ukraine | Ukrainian captain killed in Russian attack on Odesa
en.summary: A liveblog providing updates on developments in the Ukraine war, beginning with a report of a Ukrainian captain killed during a Russian attack on the port city of Odesa.

stories.title: 11 doden bij schietpartij in Zuid-Afrika, klopjacht op schutters

en.title: 11 dead in shooting in South Africa, manhunt for gunmen
en.summary: Three armed men stormed a house in a Durban township where a party was occurring and opened fire, killing eleven people including a pregnant woman and wounding three others. Police launched a manhunt for the perpetrators whose motive remains unclear.

stories.title: Marokko vandaag naar de stembus, maar jongeren blijven thuis: 'Gen Z compleet genegeerd'

en.title: Morocco heads to polls today, but young people stay home: 'Gen Z completely ignored'
en.summary: Morocco is holding elections to choose 395 new members of parliament, but youth participation appears low. Young people aged 18-24 represent only 4 percent of the 15.8 million registered voters.

stories.title: Straaljager neergestort bij Amerikaanse basis in Duitsland, piloot gebruikte schietstoel

en.title: Fighter jet crashes at U.S. base in Germany, pilot ejects safely
en.summary: An F-16 fighter jet crashed at Spangdahlem Air Base in Germany's Eifel region. The pilot ejected safely with minor injuries, and the aircraft was destroyed; the cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Consumentenbond en Booking voor het eerst tegenover elkaar in massaclaim over machtsmisbruik en misleiding van consumenten

en.title: Consumer association and Booking face each other for the first time in mass claim over abuse of power and consumer deception
en.summary: A Dutch consumer association is taking legal action against Booking in a mass claim alleging misuse of market power and deceptive practices toward consumers.

stories.title: Met verhullend taalgebruik dringen rechts-extremisten door tot politieke partijen, waarschuwen veiligheidsdiensten

en.title: Right-wing extremists infiltrate political parties using obscured language, security services warn
en.summary: Security services warn that right-wing extremists are penetrating political parties through the use of concealed language and messaging tactics.
